title: nymphaea nouchali var. zanzibariensis
intro: Nymphaea nouchali var. zanzibariensis, commonly known as blue lotus, is a variant of the blue water lily plant that is native to tropical regions of East Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its health benefits, such as promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of N. nouchali var. zanzibariensis include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including aporphine and nuciferine alkaloids, as well as flavonoids and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various health conditions, including inflammation and neurodegenerative diseases.
